subject: SIG intake: KMS chain-of-custody, wipe proofs & rotation runbook
messages:
From: Tanya Rios <tanya.rios@orchardbank.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@orchardbank.com, procurement@orchardbank.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake: KMS custody/wipeproof/rotation runbook

Alex —

As part of Orchard Bank's SIG/CAIQ intake for our pilot, the security team is collecting cryptography and KMS evidence. Can you provide the following artifacts for review by EOD Friday PST if possible?

- HSM attestation (current year) and statement of non-exportable key policy
- Sample rotation logs (last 6 months) with operator IDs redacted if needed
- Chain-of-custody description for tenant BYOK and owner-initiated key wipes
- Wipe/secure-erase proof (procedure and a sample erase certificate)
- Key-wrapping manifest showing KEK/KMS wrapping for at-rest blobs
- Operator separation / access matrix and shift log sampling
- Emergency rotation runbook (how we revoke/replace keys during incident)

If certain items need an NDA or secure transfer channel, flag that and we'll route. Also indicate any data redaction you recommend for tenant info.

Thanks,
Tanya Rios
Security Program Manager
Orchard Bank

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Rios <tanya.rios@orchardbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: KMS custody/wipeproof/rotation runbook

Tanya —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a packaged set for Orchard's SIG review. Plan below:

1) Deliverables by Tue EOD (PST): HSM attestation PDF, operator access matrix, key-wrapping manifest (redacted), and a summarized rotation runbook (v1).
2) Deliverables by Thu EOD (PST): 6-month rotation log samples (csv) with tenant IDs redacted and a sample wipe certificate for a deprovisioned tenant.
3) Security note: Full, unredacted rotation logs contain tenant identifiers and will require an SDPA/NDA or secure ShareFile transfer. We will provide redacted versions unless you request the full set via an encrypted channel.

Attachments we will send: hsm_attestation_june2026.pdf (attestation), operator_matrix.csv (access matrix), rotation_runbook_v1.md (procedural runbook), kms_rotation_sample.csv (log sample), key_wrapping_manifest.txt (wrapped-key manifest), retention_erase_statement.pdf (retention/erase statement).

Quick question: For the wipe/erase proof, do you prefer a per-tenant signed certificate or a consolidated monthly batch certificate? We can produce either; per-tenant certificates require more manual verification steps.

I'll route the artifacts via our secure drive link and share access to Orchard's security group. If you want an on-call walkthrough once you review, Marissa or I can join.

—Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Tanya Rios <tanya.rios@orchardbank.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@orchardbank.com, procurement@orchardbank.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: KMS custody/wipeproof/rotation runbook

Marissa / Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, we received the share link and the pass-down notes. A couple quick clarifying questions before we complete the intake:

1) The manifest shows "exportability: NON_EXPORTABLE" — can you confirm whether that applies to tenant KEKs (customer-supplied keys) in the BYOK workflow when a customer brings their own KEK? Specifically, are there scenarios where a KEK becomes exportable during cross-region replication or migration?

2) For the wipe/erase proof: can you provide an example of the per-tenant erase certificate and what proofs are included (timestamps, operator id, cryptographic proof-of-destruction if applicable)?

If those two items are covered in the rotation_runbook_v1.md or retention_erase_statement.pdf, point us to the exact section and we'll mark the ticket closed. Otherwise please attach the per-tenant certificate sample.

Best,
Tanya

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Rios <tanya.rios@orchardbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: KMS custody/wipeproof/rotation runbook

Tanya —

Short answers:
1) NON_EXPORTABLE applies to KEKs we manage in HSM-backed keystores. In BYOK, the customer-supplied KEK remains non-exportable in our keystore if they choose the non-exportable flag at import, and our cross-region replication uses wrapped copies (wrapped with a region-local KEK) rather than exporting raw key material. We will not export raw KEK material for replication or migration. More detail: see rotation_runbook_v1.md -> "Cross-region replication and wrap/re-wrap" section (around page 6).

2) Per-tenant erase certificate: attached sample in retention_erase_statement.pdf section B. The certificate includes: tenant id (redacted on public samples), erase timestamp (UTC), operator role and operator-id hash, the object manifest wiped, and a SHA256 digest of the erased key metadata with a nonce. For high-assurance requests we include an auditor-signed statement (we can provide a sample).

If you'd like the per-tenant, auditor-signed certificate for the Orchard pilot tenant, confirm and we'll push it over via ShareFile and include an auditor statement. Otherwise the consolidated monthly batch certificate is attached as retention_erase_statement.pdf and should satisfy SIG review for initial intake.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk the sections live; Marissa and I are available tomorrow morning PST.

—Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
